merge_llm_adapter_to_folder: merge a PEFT adapter into a base LLM and save the merged model to a local output folder
merge_llm_adapter_and_push: merge a PEFT adapter into a base LLM and push the merged model to the Hugging Face Hub
merge_llm_adapter_with_padding: merge a PEFT adapter into a base LLM with token embeddings padded to a specified multiple
review_merge_llm_adapter: review the merge_llm_adapter function to understand how it loads, merges, and saves PEFT adapters
refactor_merge_llm_adapter: refactor the merge_llm_adapter function to support additional save formats or model types
